en.headline: Labour chief says 7300 construction sites inspected under smoking ban, 84 fixed…
en.dek: Sun Yuk-han said most of the inspections since the July 17 ban were surprise checks and that contractors faced five summonses over failure to take reasonable steps.
body: Secretary for Labour and Welfare Sun Yuk-han said on Tuesday that the Labour Department had inspected 7,300 construction sites since the full smoking ban on sites took effect on 17 July, issuing 84 fixed-penalty notices.

Speaking at the 25th Hong Kong Occupational Safety and Health Award Forum and Award Presentation Ceremony, Sun said some inspections followed public complaints but the great majority were surprise checks. Of the 84 notices, 28 were based on complaints, many supported by photographs or video.

He added that five summonses had been issued to contractors in four cases where they were considered not to have taken reasonable steps to implement the ban on their sites. The department is also testing drones equipped with infrared and heat sensors to assist in identifying smoking on sites.
Sun noted that the industry is increasingly using technology in enforcement and that successful testing of the drones could help make the smoking ban more comprehensive.

zh.headline: 孫玉菡稱地盤禁煙後巡查7300個工地 發出84張定額罰款
zh.dek: 勞工及福利局局長表示大部分為突擊檢查，並向承建商發出五張告票，涉四宗未採取合理步驟個案。
body: 勞工及福利局局長孫玉菡周二表示，地盤全面禁煙自七月十七日起實施以來，勞工處已巡查7300個地盤，發出84張定額罰款通知書。
孫玉菡在第二十五屆香港職業安全健康大獎分享會暨頒獎典禮致辭時指出，部分巡查基於市民投訴，但絕大多數為突擊檢查。84張通知書中有28張基於投訴，不少附有相片或錄像。
他補充，已向承建商發出五張告票，涉及四宗個案，認為相關承建商未採取合理步驟在地盤落實全面禁煙。勞工處亦正測試配備紅外線及熱源感應器的無人機，協助巡查地盤吸煙情況。
孫玉菡提到業界在執法方面愈來愈廣泛運用科技，若無人機測試成功，有助更全面落實地盤禁煙。
